operating_statement: SMARTER governs execution; the Release Gate certifies evidence; VERITAS structures the donor narrative.

release_gate.name: Six-Check Release Gate
release_gate.summary: Could a donor, an auditor, and an academic partner read this report together and agree that every sentence is true and traceable to its source?

checks.name: Intent
checks.question: Does the report describe the gift’s purpose exactly as the gift agreement records it?
checks.rule: Block release if purpose wording or proposed use conflicts with the agreement.

checks.name: Reconciliation
checks.question: Do the financial figures reconcile to the certified year-end source?
checks.rule: Block release for any unexplained difference; any tolerance must be approved by Finance.

checks.name: Consent
checks.question: Are names, stories, quotes, and imagery permitted for the intended channels and dates?
checks.rule: Block release when required consent is absent, expired, or out of scope.

checks.name: Traceability
checks.question: Does each material claim identify its source, period, definition, and owner?
checks.rule: Block release when a material claim cannot be traced to source evidence.

checks.name: Attribution
checks.question: Does the narrative avoid causal or impact claims not demonstrated by the evidence?
checks.rule: Return overclaims for editorial and academic review before release.

checks.name: Authorization
checks.question: Is release authorized by a named, permitted human reviewer and recorded in the audit log?
checks.rule: Block release until the correct authorized approver, approval time, and version are recorded.
